Measured structure of the 54 gallery galaxies, hand-entered with a source per row in src/modules/galaxies/gallery-facts.json: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014, A&A 570, A13); RC3 (de Vaucouleurs et al. 1991, VizieR VII/155); S4G bars (Herrera-Endoqui et al. 2015, A&A 582, A86), decompositions (Salo et al. 2015, ApJS 219, 4) and pitch angles (Diaz-Garcia et al. 2019, A&A 631, A94); individual papers for black-hole masses, rings, jet, outflow and tidal tail. The 3D appearance (src/modules/galaxies/looks.json) is simulated
